subject: SOC 2 spot-check: sample access history & vetting artifacts
messages:
From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@clear-gate.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 spot-check: sample access history & vetting artifacts

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Cleargate is running a routine SOC 2 spot-check for Q3 and we'd like to validate a small sample of personnel vetting and lifecycle evidence for your engineering org. Specifically we need: 

- A redacted onboarding manifest (CSV) for ~20 recent hires (Feb 2025 - Aug 2025) showing hire date, role, recruiter, training completion flag, and background-check status.
- A separate deprovision/termination audit export covering the same window with timestamps for access removal and account disable events.
- A short chain-of-custody note describing who exported the files, redaction rules applied, and the hash values for each file.

Redaction guidance: last name may be pseudonymized or redacted; we need hire date and role intact. If you can provide SHA256 hashes of delivered files that will speed validation.

Target timeline: ideally 72 hours (by end of day 2025-09-06). If that is tight, tell us what weekend drop or scoping would work.

Delivery options: secure Drive link or S3 pre-signed URL is fine. Please CC security@clear-gate.com on delivery.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if helpful.

Amy Liu
Senior Auditor, Cleargate Financial
amy.liu@clear-gate.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@clear-gate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 spot-check: sample access history & vetting artifacts

Hi Amy — thanks for the heads up. We can do this. A couple quick clarifications before we assemble:

1) Cohort size: would you accept 15 records instead of 20? We can produce 20 but 15 lets us redaction-check faster.
2) Redaction standard: we typically pseudonymize last names and retain hire date + role; is that acceptable or do you need partial last name (e.g., "Smi****")?
3) Deprovision scope: do you want just full terminations, or also role changes where access was reduced?

I'll loop in HR ops (Stephanie) for the manifest and Security (Karthik) for the access log export. Proposed delivery: initial bundle by EOD 2025-09-05, with hashes and manifest. If you need sooner, we can push a smaller pilot today.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Security & Compliance (response owner)
Redwood Inference
